reason: One-line fix in a single Catalog.API filter that every name search goes through.
mode_reason: One-line fix in a single Catalog.API filter that every name search goes through.

items.goal: Make the catalog name filter in GetAllItems case-insensitive while keeping the starts-with semantics, so v2 ?name= and v1 /items/by/{name} both match regardless of case.
items.verifyReason: Backend-only bug in a Catalog API query filter.

alternatives.reason: The search text's % and _ would have to be escaped by hand; the ToLower plus StartsWith query is escaped by EF Core.

alternatives.option: Change the column collation with a migration
alternatives.reason: Changes the database schema; too heavy for this bug.
